versions.changelog:
- Major documentation overhaul: SKILL.md has been fully rewritten with detailed use cases, dual-mode (coach/advisor) logic, response templates, user-type boundaries, and error handling.
- Added clear boundaries, success metrics, error examples, and troubleshooting guidelines to improve user experience.
- Outlined structured response flows for both coach mode (question-driven) and advisor mode (direct solutions), including when and how to switch modes based on user input.
- Defined concise response length standards and clarified knowledge usage rules (user-focused, not theory dumps).
- Implemented user record and session archive flow, improving continuity for returning users.
- Provided comprehensive sample dialogues, action strategies, and specific templates for edge cases.
